name: unicode-decomposed-nfc
description: A byte-level positive case: a ref string given in decomposed Unicode form ("e" U+0065 followed by combining acute accent U+0301) normalises to its precomposed NFC form ("e" with acute U+00E9) before hashing. Also demonstrates that a facets member with no bound axis is omitted entirely (sparse rule) and exercises the all window kind.
notes: The ref value uses an explicitly-reserved test/ fixture namespace, not a real or spec-worked-example dcid, since this string exists purely to carry the encoding edge case -- see schemas/vectors/README.md's fixture vocabulary. input_bytes is required here per schemas/vectors/README.md's input vs input_bytes rule: re-serialising the decomposed string through any tool's own JSON writer while assembling this fixture could silently normalise it, defeating the point of the vector, so the exact UTF-8 bytes are carried opaque and hex-encoded instead.
